why: Kim, Marklof and Welsh (arXiv, Jan 2026) prove the Berry-Tabor conjecture's two-point spectral density statement for a quantum particle in a 3-dimensional box (3-tori) under a Diophantine condition on the side lengths, extending the Eskin-Margulis-Mozes 2005 two-dimensional case via values of ternary quadratic forms.

found.title: Values of ternary quadratic forms at integers and the Berry-Tabor conjecture for 3-tori
found.note: Preprint proving the Berry-Tabor conjecture's two-point statistics for 3-dimensional rectangular boxes under a Diophantine condition; not read.
